references.text: God's promise to blot out the memory of Amalek, which he commanded Moses to write down as a reminder
The Lord's oath to wage war against Amalek from generation to generation
Balaam's prophecy that Amalek was the first among the nations, but would ultimately perish
God's command to Saul to punish Amalek for what they did to Israel when they came up out of Egypt
Saul's war against the Amalekites and the capture of King Agag
Samuel reminds Saul that he did not carry out the Lord's anger against Amalek
The descendants of Simeon struck down the remaining Amalekites and settled in their territory
The context explaining why Israel was to destroy Amalek - their attack on the weak and weary
